items.why: Still riding Friday's better than expected Q3 delivery beat: 486,532 vehicles against roughly 462,000 expected. Momentum carried into Monday ahead of the Oct 21 earnings report.
Foxconn posted record September quarter revenue, up 47% year over year, signaling strong demand for AI servers housing Nvidia chips. The stock pushed toward a record high.
Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy with a $665 target, calling Microsoft the trusted 'adults in charge' of enterprise AI amid safety fears around frontier models.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Crude futures slipped toward $90 a barrel as equities rallied and demand chatter stayed muted.

market_note: Nasdaq hit a fresh record as tech led; 10Y yield held near a 24-year high.
summary: Big tech carried the tape Monday, with the Nasdaq setting a fresh intraday record while oil slid. Investors mostly shrugged off the 10-year Treasury touching its highest yield in 24 years.
